purpose: Teach: 士郎/一太郎/大竹/せりふ/ぶた/オトコ/メンズ/いっか

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、Fateの士郎ファンだったろ
lines.en: Riku, you were a huge Fate Shiro fan, weren't you?
lines.style: Playful jab delivered with confidence. Knowing smirk in the voice. Fast, pointed — the rhythm of someone teasing someone they know well.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、レポート提出で一太郎使ってたな、桜
lines.en: Oh, you're one to talk — I saw you using Ichitaro for that report, Sakura.
lines.style: Light, caught-in-the-act counter. Gentle tease back. Slight smile underneath. Meeting her energy without defensiveness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、大竹まことのラジオ聴いてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were listening to Otake Makoto's radio show all the time.
lines.style: Wry lob. Slightly higher pitch on the accusation. Enjoying the rhythm of calling him out. Sustained eye contact through the whole thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭の演劇でせりふ覚えたろ、桜
lines.en: And you memorized all your lines for the culture festival play. Come on, Sakura.
lines.style: Turning it back on her. Quieter than her last shot — the tone of someone who watches what she does. A small laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、給食でぶた肉の調理苦手だったろ
lines.en: Riku, you were terrible at cooking pork in home ec, remember?
lines.style: Sharp, specific memory. Quick rhythm. The satisfaction of a perfect detail. Small laugh at the end — not mean, just delighted.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、漫画で「オトコの中のオトコ」って表現使ってたな、桜
lines.en: You literally used the phrase 'a man among men' in your manga notebook, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat delivery with maximum effect. Pause after the phrase — letting it land. Barely containing laughter. The voice of someone reading something embarrassing aloud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、メンズ用品売り場で迷ってたな
lines.en: Riku, didn't I see you standing around lost in the men's section at the drugstore?
lines.style: Innocent-sounding setup. Curious lilt — the fake innocence of someone about to land a solid hit. Playful, searching.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト終わって「もういっか」って気抜けてたな、桜
lines.en: You literally checked out after that test and went 'whatever,' totally zoning out, Sakura.
lines.style: Close and conspiratorial. Soft, wry. The voice of someone who noticed and is amused by it. Trailing off slightly — like he's still holding back a laugh.
